stem: The masses, in grams, of apples from a certain farm have mean $\mu$ and standard deviation 5.2. The farmer says that the value of $\mu$ is 64.6. A quality control inspector claims that the value of $\mu$ is actually less than 64.6. In order to test his claim he chooses a random sample of 100 apples from the farm.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The mean mass of the 100 apples is found to be 63.5 g.

Carry out the test at the 2.5% significance level.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Later another test of the same hypotheses at the 2.5% significance level, with another random sample of 100 apples from the same farm, is carried out.

Given that the value of $\mu$ is in fact 62.7, calculate the probability of a Type II error.
